name: editor
summary: Rich text on a contenteditable, driven from the markup's own buttons.

area.doc: The contenteditable the text is written in.

revision.doc: Counts changes to the content and the selection; isActive reads it to repaint.

linking.doc: Whether a link address is being typed.

run.doc: Runs a command: bold italic underline strike, heading subheading paragraph quote code, bullets numbers rule, undo redo.

isActive.doc: Whether a command applies where the selection is; the same names, plus link.

beginLink.doc: Remembers the selection while the address is typed elsewhere.

applyLink.doc: Links the remembered selection; only http(s), mailto, tel, relative and # addresses.

cancelLink.doc: Gives up the link and puts the selection back.

unlink.doc: Removes the link where the selection is.
